mapper.insert: insert into T_MDM_PRODUCT_VULCANIZING(factory_code, year, month, vulcanizing_machine_id, product_code, product_type_code, vulcanizing_machine_code, mould_code, create_by) select distinct tmmppf.factory_code, #{generateYear}, #{generateMonth}, tmmppf.vulcanizing_machine_id, tmmppf.PRODUCT_CODE, tmmppf.product_type_code, tmmppf.vulcanizing_machine_code, tmmppf.MOULD_CODE, #{username} from t_mp_month_plan_vulcanizing_final tmmppf where tmmppf.IS_DELETE = 0 and tmmppf.YEAR = #{fromYear} and tmmppf.month = #{fromMonth} and tmmppf.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} and IFNULL(tmmppf.${productionDayField}, 0) > 0
